blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: One of the first steps of a research pipeline is generating ideas. Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to automate this step, but most of this work optimizes the quality of individual ideas, while overlooking diversity. In our work, we study document-grounded ideation, focusing on increasing the diversity of LLM generated ideas and ensuring they are high quality. Given prior papers, a model must propose a set of ideas that are each high-quality and clearly distinct from one another, while also being grounded in the input documents. To optimize for this, we propose training with a set-level reinforcement learning objective. In our setup, in a single generation, the model writes K structured idea cards grounded in the source papers, and the set is scored jointly, where each idea's quality is weighted by its distance from the ideas written before it. This teaches the model to steer each new idea away from its predecessors. We show that our trained 8B model achieves higher creative utility (a measure combining quality and diversity) than Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-6 Astra on our contamination-free benchmark. In a pilot human study with four experts, our sets are judged as promising as Claude Opus 4.8's and contain marginally more unique ideas. When a coding agent runs proof-of-concept experiments on the ideas, our model's success@k is comparable to Claude Opus 4.8's, so we see that the added diversity does not cost any executability.
blocks.zh: 研究管道的最初步骤之一是产生想法。 大语言模型(LLMs)越来越多地被用来自动化这个步骤,但大部分作品优化了个人思想的质量,同时忽略了多样性. 在我们的工作中,我们研究以文件为基础的思想,重点是增加LLM所产生的思想的多样性,并确保这些思想的质量。 鉴于以前的文件,一个模式必须提出一套想法,这些想法都是高质量的,彼此明显不同,同时也以投入文件为基础。 为了优化这项工作,我们建议进行培训,并设定加强学习的目标。 在我们的设定中,在一代人中,模型会写出K结构化的思想卡,以源论文为基础,而集被联合打分,其中每个思想的质量会根据其与所写思想的距离来加权. 这教导了这个模式将每个新思想从前作中引出. 我们显示,我们训练有素的8B模型比克洛德·奥普斯·4.8和GPT-6 Astra在无污染基准上更具有创造性。 在一次由四名专家参与的试验性人类研究中,我们的套装被评为与克洛德·奥普斯4.8的套装一样有前途并含有略微更独特的想法. 当一个编码代理对这些想法进行概念证明实验时,我们模型的成功@k可以和克洛德·奥普斯4.8的相当,因此我们看到增加的多样性并不花费任何可执行性.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The first step of any research cycle is generating ideas worth testing, before an experiment can tell you which one was right. Current work with Large Language Models (LLMs) on idea generation has focused on one of two things: producing a single idea and scoring it against an existing, held-out idea ( He-Yueya et al., 2026 ) , or building end-to-end systems that carry one idea through execution and judge whether that execution succeeded ( Kirgis et al., 2026 ; Ning et al., 2026 ; Falck et al., 2026 ; Garikaparthi et al., 2026 ; Si et al., 2026 ) . Either way, an idea is generated and judged on its own, never alongside other candidates it could be weighed against.
blocks.zh: 任何研究周期的第一步都是产生值得测试的想法, 在实验能告诉你哪个是正确的之前。 目前与"大语言模型"(LLMs)在思想生成方面的工作主要集中于两个方面之一:产生一个单一的想法,并对照一个现有的,被搁置的想法(He-Yueya等人,2026年)进行评分,或者建立端到端的系统,通过处决传递一个想法,判断处决是否成功(Kirgis等人,2026年;Ning等人,2026年;Falck等人,2026年;Garikaparthi等人,2026年;Si等人,2026年). 无论哪种方式,一个想法都是靠自己产生和判断的,永远不能与其他候选人一道加以权衡。

blocks.en: Looking at how humans do research, a researcher facing a body of literature brainstorms several directions off the same shared context, and then selects among them using some signal ( Platt, 1964 ; Klahr and Dunbar, 1988 ) , rather than just committing to one idea. We draw a connection between ideation and creative problem solving. The brainstorm-then-select process is how creative thinking/problem solving can also be formalized, divergent thinking explores a space broadly for many candidates, and convergent thinking narrows it through selection ( Boden, 2004 ; Guilford, 1967 ) . The way current LLMs are used for ideation can look different. Because each idea is generated and judged on its own, multiple candidates come from repeated independent sampling, with no shared context to explore deliberately and no pool to converge over. Any diversity among them is incidental rather than designed ( Puri et al., 2026 ; Bahlous-Boldi et al., 2026 ) . Work on autonomous research agents has also flagged diversity as a shortcoming ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Garikaparthi et al., 2026 ) . Also previous attempts at training an ideation model against execution signal has been shown to collapse onto a single dominant idea rather than a spread of them ( Si et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 研究人类如何进行研究,一个面对一系列文献的研究人员,从同一个共同的语境中抽出几个方向,然后用一些信号在他们中选择(Platt,1964;Klahr and Dunbar,1988),而不是仅仅致力于一个想法. 我们把思想和创造性问题的解决联系起来。 脑暴-当时的选择过程是创造性思维/问题解决如何也可以正规化,不同思维为许多候选人广泛探索一个空间,而趋同思维则通过选择来缩小它(Boden, 2004; Guilford, 1967). 当前LLMS用于构思的方式可以看起来不同. 因为每个想法都是自己产生和判断的,所以多个候选人来自反复的独立采样,没有共同的上下文来有意探索,也没有集合的集合. 其中的任何多样性都是偶然的,而不是设计的(Puri等人,2026年;Bahlous-Boldi等人,2026年)。 关于自主研究代理人的工作也指出多样性是一个缺点(Liu等人,2026年;Garikaparthi等人,2026年)。 先前曾试图针对执行信号训练一种想法模型,但事实证明,这种想法已经落入单一的主导思想之中,而不是传播(Si等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: In our work, we close this gap by treating idea generation as a creative search problem. Given a corpus of prior documents, an agent should propose a set of K K ideas, each grounded in specific source documents, that are high-quality and differ from each other by design. We study this for document-grounded ideation ( Wang et al., 2024 ) . We combine quality and diversity into one set-level training signal by adapting the Creative Utility formulation ( Wadhwa et al., 2026 ) where each idea earns credit for its own quality and for its distance from the ideas emitted before it, so a redundant idea earns little no matter how well-written it is (as illustrated in Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh: 在我们的工作中,我们通过将思想生成视为一个创造性的搜索问题来弥补这一差距. 鉴于一系列先前的文件,代理人应提出一套K K想法,这些想法都以具体来源文件为基础,质量高,设计上各不相同。 我们研究这一点是为了基于文件的构想(Wang等人,2024年)。 我们把质量和多样性综合为一个固定的培训信号,通过调整创意工具(Wadhwa et al., 2026年)的配方(Wadhwa et al., 2026年), 每一个想法在质量上以及与其之前所提出想法的距离上都获得了功劳,所以一个多余的想法无论写得多么好,都几乎没有收入(如图1所示)。

blocks.en: To achieve this, we train an ideation model (Qwen3-8B ( Team, 2025 ) ) in two steps. We first do a supervised fine-tuning step to initialize the policy on well-formed idea sets, followed by GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) against a set-level objective (adapted from the creative utility formulation). We then report this utility measure on a contamination-free test set that we put together. We also look at two existing benchmarks, GiantsBench ( He-Yueya et al., 2026 ) and IdeaSeed ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . Our tested baselines include the untrained base model and its SFT checkpoint, strong closed-source agents, GIANTS ( He-Yueya et al., 2026 ) , and DARLING ( Li et al., 2025 ) , an alternative quality-diversity objective that we retrain in our setting.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们分两步训练一个构思模型(Qune3-8B(Team,2025)). 我们首先进行一个有监督的微调步骤,以启动关于完善的成套想法的政策,然后是GRPO(Shao等人,2024年)针对一个设定目标(从创造性的效用表述中调整). 然后,我们报告这个公用措施 在一个没有污染的测试装置, 我们一起。 我们还研究了现有的两个基准,Giants Bench(He-Yueya等人,2026年)和IdeaSeed(Chen等人,2026年)。 我们测试的基线包括未经训练的基建模型及其SFT检查站、强大的封闭源码代理、GIANTS(He-Yueya等人,2026年)和DARLING(Li等人,2025年),这是我们在环境中重新培训的另一个质量多样性目标。

blocks.en: We show that our 8B trained model achieves the highest creative utility on our test set, outperforming strong closed-source agents and competing quality-diversity objectives such as DARLING. A small pilot human study with four expert annotators finds that our sets are comparable to Claude Opus 4.8’s in the number of promising ideas, while containing more mutually distinct ones. Finally, when we execute each set of ideas in a fixed sandbox with a coding agent, our model is comparable to Claude Opus 4.8 on success@ k k , showing that we are able to increase diversity without compromising important aspects of ideation like executability.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,我们的8B训练有素的模式在测试中实现了最高的创造性效用,超越了强大的封闭源代码代理以及诸如DARLING等相互竞争的质量多样性目标。 我们的套装与克劳德·奥普斯·4.8的套装相当, 最后,当我们在装有编码剂的固定沙盒中执行每组想法时,我们的模型与关于成功的Claude Opus 4.8相当@ kk),表明我们能够在不影响可执行性等思想的重要方面的情况下增加多样性.

blocks.en: Contributions Our contributions are (1) a set-level RL objective for training that balances quality and diversity; (2) an instantiation of this objective for document-grounded ideation; and (3) an 8B trained ideation model that outperforms strong closed-source agents and models trained on competing objectives on creative utility, and whose ideas are comparably promising in a small pilot human and execution study.
blocks.zh: 捐款 我们的贡献是:(1) 在培训方面平衡质量和多样性的既定RL目标;(2) 在基于文件的构思方面立即提出这一目标;(3) 8B训练有素的构思模型,它比在创造性用途方面的竞争目标方面受过训练的强大封闭来源代理人和模型表现得更好,在一次小型人和执行试验研究中,它们的想法是相当有希望的。

blocks.en: 2 Training with a Set-Level Reward
blocks.zh: 2 带有定级奖励的培训

blocks.en: 2.1 Background
blocks.zh: 2.1 背景情况

blocks.en: We start by describing the standard reinforcement learning setting for language models we build on. A policy parameterized as an LM π θ \pi_{\theta} maps a prompt x x to a distribution over textual outputs y y . Given a reward function R ⁡ ( x , y ) ∈ ℝ R(x,y)\in\mathbb{R} , training aims to maximize expected reward: max θ 𝔼 x ∼ D , y ∼ π θ ( ⋅ ∣ x ) [ R ( x , y ) ] . \max_{\theta}\ \mathbb{E}_{x\sim D,\ y\sim\pi_{\theta}(\cdot\mid x)}\big[R(x,y)\big]. (1) We optimize Equation 1 with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) ( Shao et al., 2024 ) : for each x x , we sample G G rollouts { y 1 , … , y G } ∼ π θ ( ⋅ ∣ x ) \{y_{1},\dots,y_{G}\}\sim\pi_{\theta}(\cdot\mid x) , score each with R ⁡ ( x , y g ) R(x,y_{g}) , and update the policy using each rollout’s advantage relative to the group’s mean reward, with no learned critic.
2.2 Set-Level objective
blocks.zh: 2.2 设定目标

blocks.en: In our setting, each prompt x x is answered by a set of K K outputs U = { u 1 , … , u K } U=\{u_{1},\dots,u_{K}\} written in a single generation, after a shared reasoning prefix. This set is the rollout y y in Eq. 1 , so GRPO scores it with one scalar and computes one advantage per set. All K K outputs therefore share that single credit signal. Our goal is a set that is high-quality and whose outputs are mutually distinct. blocks.en: For each item in the generation, we multiply its quality by how far it is from its nearest predecessor and aggregate over the set to get the reward. A redundant but high quality item earns almost nothing (Fig 1 ).
blocks.zh: 对于这代人的每件物品,我们用它的质量乘以它离最近的前身有多远,并用它的总和来得到奖励。 多余但质量高的物品几乎一无所获(图1).

blocks.en: The objective has two components: a quality function q ⁡ ( u i ) ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] q(u_{i})\in[0,1] that scores an output for the prompt, and a distance d ⁡ ( ⋅ , ⋅ ) ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] d(\cdot,\cdot)\in[0,1] between two outputs. Any task with a quality signal and a notion of diversity fits, such as instruction following, creative writing, or ideation; we instantiate both for document-grounded ideation in Section 3.1 .
blocks.zh: 目标有两个组成部分:质量函数 q q (u i) Q Q [0, 1] q (u i)\ in [0, 1] 对一个输出进行评分, 以及两个输出之间的距离 d Q  ( Q , ) Q [0, 1] d (\ cdot,\ cdot)\ in [0, 1] 。 任何带有质量信号和多样性概念的任务都符合要求,例如按照指示、创造性的写作或想法;我们在第3.1节中将这两点都作为文件依据的构想。

blocks.en: Relation to Creative Utility. Eq. 2 is adapted from Creative Utility (CU) ( Wadhwa et al., 2026 ) , which scores a set of ideas by the quality each one adds beyond the ideas already selected. We make two design choices in adapting it to a training reward. First, CU applies a patience discount ( γ \gamma ) to later ideas; we drop it for training, so every idea in the set is weighted equally and a model cannot fall back on generating weak ideas later in the set. Second, CU takes the best ordering of the set; we instead use the order in which the model writes them. Our prompt asks the model to list ideas from most to least promising, and it lets the reward be computed directly from a single rollout. At evaluation we report CU as is (Section 4 ).
blocks.zh: 与"创意实用"的关系. Eq. 2 改编自创意工具(CU)(Wadhwa et al., 2026年),它根据每套想法的质量对一组想法进行评分,它们都超越了已经选定的想法. 我们做了两个设计选择 适应训练奖励。 首先,CU对后期的想法实行忍耐折扣(γ\gamma);我们放弃它来训练,所以集中的每一个想法都得到同等的加权,一个模型不能在集的后期再产生软弱的想法. 其次,CU对套装进行最好的排序;我们而是使用模型写出的顺序. 我们的及时性要求模型列出从大多数到最没有希望的想法,它让奖励直接通过一次推出来计算. 在评价时,我们报告重罪股的情况(第4节)。

blocks.en: Relation to multi-answer RL. Our proposed objective can be viewed as a generalized form of the set-level objective introduced by Puri et al. (2026) . Their formulation however has no notion of distance and instead only checks for coverage against an established ground truth answer set. Their objective can be defined as a special case of Eq 2 , by setting d ⁡ ( u i , u j ) = 1 d(u_{i},u_{j})=1 and q q to a coverage metric.
blocks.zh: 与多答RL的关系. 我们拟议的目标可被视为普里等人(2026年)提出的设定目标的一般形式。 但是,其表述没有距离概念,而只是对照既定的地面真相答案来检查覆盖面。 其目标可以定义为Eq 2的特例,设置d → (u i, u j ) = 1 d (u_{i), u_{j ) = 1 and q q 到 覆盖度度量.

blocks.en: 3 Document Grounded Ideation
blocks.zh: 3 文档设定

blocks.en: As mentioned in Section 1 , we study the task of document-grounded ideation i.e. given a body of related literature, an agent needs to generate a set of ideas worth pursuing next, and we evaluate the set of ideas for its quality and diversity.
blocks.zh: 正如第1节所述,我们研究了基于文件的构想的任务,即鉴于一系列相关文献,一个代理人需要产生一套值得追求的想法,我们评价一套想法的质量和多样性。

blocks.en: Task definition. An instance is a corpus of documents D = { d 1 , … , d n } D=\{d_{1},\dots,d_{n}\} (each a scientific paper, given as a summary). An agent must produce a set of K K ideas U = { u 1 , … , u K } U=\{u_{1},\dots,u_{K}\} , where each idea u i u_{i} is a structured idea card with four fields: a problem gap , a core claim , a method , and an inspiration field that names the specific source documents the idea draws on and how.
blocks.zh: 任务定义. 实例是文件 D = { d 1,..., d n } D = d =\ dots, d_{n } (每篇科学论文,作为摘要). 代理商必须制作一套 K K 想法 U = {u 1,..., u K } U {u },\ dots, u_{K }, 其中每个想法 u i u_{i} 是一个结构化的思想卡, 包含四个字段: 问题差距, 核心主张, 方法, 以及一个给特定源代码命名的启发字段 , 用于记录该想法所汲取的和如何使用 。

blocks.en: Why a set of K K ? We make the set the primary unit, generating all K K ideas in one pass so each is written conditioned on those already emitted. The agent can actively avoid repeating itself, steering later ideas toward directions its earlier ones left uncovered, rather than relying on independent draws to spread apart by chance ( Puri et al., 2026 ; Bahlous-Boldi et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 为什么是一套KK? 我们把设定作为主要单位, 产生所有 K 想法在一个通道中, 所以每个文件都以已经发射的为条件。 代理人可以积极避免自我重复,将后来的想法引向其早先发现的方向,而不是依靠独立抽图偶然分散(Puri等人,2026年;Bahlous-Boldi等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: See Appendix A.1 for definitions of the idea card sub fields and examples of ideas.
blocks.zh: 关于思想卡子字段的定义和想法的例子,见附录A.1.

blocks.zh: 3.1 奖励证据

blocks.en: Quality: A part of ideation is to come up with directions that are worth pursuing next, so we define quality as long-term scientific impact ( Tong et al., 2026 ) . While there are other properties of good ideas such as fluency or soundness, these are not sufficient to decide if the idea is worth pursuing next. We therefore treat soundness as a separate axis, which we only probe with a small execution check (Section 6.2 ), rather than the training target. We anchor long-term impact to the gold idea g g , a reference idea whose value is already established, so the judgment reflects what the field found worth doing. Section 3.2 describes how we obtain g g . We model impact as a pairwise judgment between the generated idea u u and the gold idea g g :

blocks.en: For impact reward we use an off-the-shelf reward model, SciJudge-30B ( Tong et al., 2026 ) and for distance we use gpt-oss-120b ( OpenAI, 2025 ) . Details around the prompts and human validation are in the Appendix C .

blocks.en: 3.2 Data
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据

blocks.en: We build a training set and a contamination-free test set from published papers. Our data construction pipeline has two steps: (a) gathering the source and target documents (b) generating data for supervised fine-tuning. Each instance pairs a target paper (or gold idea) with its source documents .
blocks.zh: 我们从已发表的论文中建造了一套培训和一套无污染测试。 我们的数据构建管道有两个步骤:(a) 收集资料来源和目标文件;(b) 生成数据以供监督微调。 每个实例将目标纸(或黄金想法)与源文件配对。

blocks.en: Gathering documents. We take each paper in the training split of GiantsBench ( He-Yueya et al., 2026 ) as a target and retrieve its full text and citation graph, including the in-text context of each citation. An LLM ( claude-sonnet-4-6 ) selects the source documents from the target’s references, keeping those that motivated the paper, exposed the gap it addresses, supplied its conceptual foundation, or were directly extended ( Cohan et al., 2019 ) . Each source is summarized into a source card in the idea-card schema, and the cards form the input corpus D D . The target’s text is summarized into an idea card and held out as the gold idea g g . We drop instances with two or fewer source documents or no gold idea. For training we focus on the Language domain. The test set is built using the same pipeline but with target papers 2026 (Section 4 ). The test split also spans 16 domains (distribution in Figure 5 , Appendix A ).
blocks.zh: 集诸文件. 我们把Giants Bench(He-Yueya等人,2026年)的训练分裂中的每一篇论文作为目标,并检索其全文和引文图表,包括每篇引文的内文上下文。 一个LLM(claude-sonnet-4-6)从目标参考物中选择源文件,保留那些激发论文,暴露论文所处理的差距,提供其概念基础,或直接被扩展的文件(Cohan等人,2019年). 每个来源被归纳为理想卡图案中的源卡,卡片构成输入符D. 目标内容被归纳为思想卡, 我们放弃两个或更少的源文件或没有黄金想法的例子。 为了培训,我们侧重于语言领域。 试验装置使用同一管道建造,但有目标文件2026(第4节)。 测试划分还跨越16个域(分布于图5,附录A.)。

blocks.en: SFT data construction The SFT stage teaches the idea-card format and a thinking pattern. A teacher LLM ( claude-opus-4.8 ) first proposes K K ideas from the source documents alone. Because we cannot access a closed model’s reasoning, we then use hindsight prompting, where the teacher sees the sources and its own ideas and writes a first-person exploration that arrives at exactly those ideas, floating and rejecting candidates, hedging over the sources and raising questions. Each instance gets a different opening statement so traces do not collapse into one template. We train on 7,172 instances and use 1,740 1{,}740 for testing. Appendix A has details about the train and test splits.
blocks.zh: SFT 数据构建 SFT舞台教授思想卡格式和思维模式. 教师LLM(claude-opus-4.8)首先从源文件单独提出K思想. 因为我们无法了解一个封闭模型的推理,我们然后使用后视提示,老师在那里看到源头和自己的想法,写出一个第一人称的探索,得出准确的这些想法,漂浮和拒绝候选人,套取源头并提出问题。 每个实例都得到不同的开口语句,这样痕迹就不会崩溃成一个模板. 我们训练了7,172次 并使用1,740 1{,}740测试。 附 录 A有列车和试车拆分的细节.

blocks.en: 3.3 Training Details
blocks.zh: 3.3 培训详情

blocks.en: Our proposed training setup has two steps: (a) light supervised fine-tuning with next token prediction to teach the model the format of our task as well as the thinking pattern, and, (b) GRPO as the base RL algorithm. We use Qwen3-8B ( Team, 2025 ) as the base model with a maximum response length of 16k tokens, and we set K = 3 K=3 . We repeat these two steps for two setups of training: (i) with think : where we optimize for the thinking traces that we constructed in the previous section and (ii) no think : where we only optimize for the final answer block and have an empty think block.
blocks.zh: 我们拟议的培训设置有两个步骤:(a) 光监督微调,用下一个符号预测来教导模型我们的任务形式和思维模式;(b) GRPO作为基础RL算法。 我们使用Qwen3-8B(Team,2025年)作为基模型,最大响应长度为16k令牌,我们设定了K=3K=3. 我们重复这两个步骤进行两个训练的设置: (一)用思考:我们优化我们在上一节所构建的思维痕迹和 (二)无思考:我们仅优化最后的答案块,而有一个空思考块.

blocks.en: We also show the recipe generalization on Olmo-3-7B-Think-SFT ( Olmo et al., 2025 ) . The hyperparameters, SFT variants, Olmo-3 details and compute details are in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 我们还对Olmo-3-7B-Think-SFT作了说明(Olmo等人,2025年)。 超参数,SFT变体,Olmo-3细节和计算细节见附录B.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: Baselines. We compare a model trained with our proposed objective against four groups of systems.
blocks.zh: 基线。 我们把一个训练有素的模型与我们提议的目标比作四组系统。

blocks.en: General models. We evaluate strong closed-source models (Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-6 Astra) and a representative open-source model (Nemotron-120B ( NVIDIA, 2025 ) ), prompted zero-shot with our set-generation prompt.
blocks.zh: 一般型号. 我们评价了强大的闭源模型(Claude Opus 4.8和GPT-6 Astra)和具有代表性的开源模型(Nemotron-120B(NVIDIA,2025年)),随着我们的设定生成的迅速,引发了零镜头.

blocks.en: Competing objectives. DARLING ( Li et al., 2025 ) is the closest approach to ours that optimizes quality and diversity together, but across the rollouts of a single-idea policy rather than within the generated set. We replicate the algorithm for our task and train it with K = 1 K=1 , so the only difference from our method is where diversity is enforced (Appendix B.3 ). Impact-only RL uses our set-level RL setup with the diversity term removed (i.e., d = 1 d=1 in Eq. 2 ), and isolates what the diversity term contributes. Impact+diversity, no SFT uses our full reward but starts GRPO directly from the base model, and isolates what the SFT warm-start contributes. These are trained from the same base model and training corpus as our method.
blocks.zh: 相互竞争的目标。 DARLING(Li等人,2025年)是同我们最接近的方法,它将质量和多样性结合起来优化,但贯穿于单一思想政策的推出,而不是在生成的组合之内。 我们复制我们的任务的算法,用 K = 1 K = 1 来训练它,所以与我们的方法唯一的区别是执行多样性的地方(附录 B 3 ). 仅影响RL使用我们设定的RL设置,并删除多样性术语(即d=1d=1在Eq. 2中),并隔离多样性术语的贡献. " 影响+多样性 " ,没有SFT使用我们的全额奖励,但直接从基模型开始GPRO,并隔离SFT温暖启动的贡献。 这些培训与我们的方法一样,都来自同一个基础模式和培训机构。

blocks.en: Base and SFT. Qwen3-8B (base) is the untrained base model, prompted for K K ideas directly. SFT is the checkpoint after supervised initialization and before GRPO. Both are the starting points for our method.
blocks.zh: 基地和SFT号 Qune3-8B(base)是未经训练的基模型,直接为K思想所激发. SFT是监督初始化后和GRPO前的检查站. 两者都是我们方法的起点。

blocks.en: Proposed. Proposed is SFT followed by GRPO with our set-level reward (Eq. 2 ). For SFT and Proposed we report two variants: think and no think .
blocks.zh: 提议。 提议是SFT,然后是GRPO, 并给予我们设定等级的奖励(第2项)。 对于SFT和提议,我们报告两个变体:思考和不思考。

blocks.en: Benchmarks. We evaluate the above on three datasets. 1. Ours (contamination-free). To measure generalization free of contamination (target papers from 2026), we evaluate on the test-set as explained in Section 3.2 . We have 1,740 1{,}740 evaluation instances across 16 domains. 2. GiantsBench ( He-Yueya et al., 2026 ) . The input for this dataset is two documents. We evaluate on its held-out test split which has 2,374 instances and is disjoint from the training split we use for our data (Section 3.2 ). We compare our model against GIANTS-4B, which was trained on the GiantsBench train split (Appendix D ). 3. IdeaSeed ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . A dataset of 11k pairs of published papers, each with a human-written proposal and its related-work context, which acts as input. We use this benchmark to test whether a trained model keeps the breadth of idea types that the research community pursues. We report this on a sample of 500 instances (Appendix D ).
blocks.zh: 基准。 我们通过三个数据集评估上述情况。 1. 我们的(无污染)。 如第3.2节所述,为了衡量无污染的通用性(2026年的目标文件),我们对试验套件进行评价。 我们共有1 740 1{,}740次评价,涉及16个领域。 2. 巨人奔驰(He-Yueya等人,2026年). 此数据集的输入是两个文档. 我们评估其搁置的测试分期进行,测试分期进行,有2 374次,与我们的数据所用培训分期进行脱节(第3.2节)。 我们的车型与GIANTS-4B相比,GIANTS-4B在巨人本奇列车的拆分(Appendix D)上接受了训练. 3. 思想种子(Chen等人,2026年). 由11k对已发表论文组成的数据集,每集都有人文写作的建议及其相关工作背景,起到投入的作用. 我们用这个基准来测试一个训练有素的模型是否保持研究界所追求的思想类型的广度. 我们以500例抽样报告(附录D)。

blocks.en: Ours (contamination-free). To measure generalization free of contamination (target papers from 2026), we evaluate on the test-set as explained in Section 3.2 . We have 1,740 1{,}740 evaluation instances across 16 domains.

We evaluate on its held-out test split which has 2,374 instances and is disjoint from the training split we use for our data (Section 3.2 ). We compare our model against GIANTS-4B, which was trained on the GiantsBench train split (Appendix D ).

We use this benchmark to test whether a trained model keeps the breadth of idea types that the research community pursues. We report this on a sample of 500 instances (Appendix D ).
blocks.zh: 思想种子(陈等,2026年). 由11k对已发表论文组成的数据集,每集都有人文写作的建议及其相关工作背景,起到投入的作用. 我们用这个基准来测试一个训练有素的模型是否保持研究界所追求的思想类型的广度. 我们以500例抽样报告(附录D)。

blocks.en: Metrics. Our primary metric is Creative Utility (CU) ( Wadhwa et al., 2026 ) : CU ⁡ ( U ) = max τ ⁡ ∑ i = 1 | U | γ i − 1 ​ q ​ ( u τ ⁡ ( i ) ) ​ min j < i ⁡ d ⁡ ( u τ ⁡ ( i ) , u τ ⁡ ( j ) ) ∑ i = 1 | U | γ i − 1 , \mathrm{CU}(U)=\max_{\tau}\;\frac{\sum_{i=1}^{|U|}\gamma^{\,i-1}\,q\big(u_{\tau(i)}\big)\min_{j<i}d\big(u_{\tau(i)},u_{\tau(j)}\big)}{\sum_{i=1}^{|U|}\gamma^{\,i-1}}, (5)

Here τ \tau ranges over orderings of the set U U , q q is quality, d d is distance (with min j < 1 ⁡ d := 1 \min_{j<1}d:=1 ), and γ ∈ ( 0 , 1 ] \gamma\in(0,1] is a patience discount on later ideas. The denominator normalizes CU to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . The maximum over orderings is combinatorial, so, following Wadhwa et al. (2026) , we evaluate it with the greedy order. We use γ = 0.9 \gamma=0.9 and K = 3 K=3 .

blocks.en: We also report two components of the reward separately. Quality ( q q ) is the average length-controlled win rate ( Dubois et al., 2024 ) of an idea against the gold idea (Eq. 3 ) as a strict win-rate, judged with GPT-5.4-mini (Appendix C.1 ). Distance ( d d ) is the mean pairwise distance d ⁡ ( u i , u j ) d(u_{i},u_{j}) within the set (Eq. 4 ), judged with gemini-3.5-flash . We also report grounding ( g g ), an LLM judge’s assessment of how crucial and faithful each idea’s declared source support is to what the documents actually claim. Grounding is judged with gemini-3.5-flash .
blocks.zh: 我们还分别报告奖励的两个部分。 质量(q q )是指一个反对黄金思想(Eq 3 )的想法,以GPT-5.4-mini(Appendix C.1 )来判断的平均长度控制赢率(Dubois et al., 2024). 距离 (d d) 是一组(Eq. 4)内的平均对称距离 d Q(u i, u j) d(u i), u j) , 以 gemini-3.5- flash 判断. 我们还报告一个LLM法官对每个想法所宣称的来源支持对文件实际说法有多重要和忠实的评估(gg)。 地表被判定为基因3.5-闪光。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: Proposed (no think) achieves the highest Creative Utility Table 1 , shows that the proposed model trained with the set-level reward and no thinking, Proposed (no think) , achieves the highest creative utility and win-rate, with high distance between ideas. This utility increases from 0.03 (base model), to 0.21 (SFT no think) to 0.64 post our proposed training (no think). We also beat state of the art closed source models, where Claude Opus 4.8 achieves a CU of only 0.38 and GPT-6 Astra achieves 0.28. The thinking variant of our proposed training, Proposed (think) achieves a utility of 0.51, which still beats both closed-source models but is lower than the no-think variant and on par with DARLING (0.52) and the no-SFT ablation (0.51). We discuss this trade-off at the end of this section. The high creative utility is because both impact against gold (win-rate) and idea diversity are high for our proposed model. Full table in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 提议(无思想)实现最高的创意工具表1,显示拟议模式经过定级奖励训练,没有思维,提议(无思想),实现最高的创意效用和双赢率,思想间距离很远. 这种效用从0.03(基准模式)增加到0.21(SFT无思索),到0.64(无思索),成为我们拟议培训的对象。 我们还击败了最先进的闭源模型,其中克劳德·奥普斯4.8实现的CU只有0.38,GPT-6 Astra实现0.28. 我们拟议培训的思维变体“拟议(思维)”的效用为0.51,它仍然比闭源模式要低,但低于无思维变体,与DARLING(0.52)和无SFT(0.51)。 我们在本节末尾讨论这种权衡。 高创造性的效用在于,对于我们提议的模型来说,对黄金(双赢率)和思想多样性的影响都很大。 附录E中的完整表格

blocks.en: Proposed training recipe beats different competing objectives Training with a set level objective for only quality ( Impact-only RL ) gives a good win-rate (43%), but it collapses the set. Its average distance falls to 0.38. This shows that training for quality only in a set can get us good ideas, but the model ends up focusing on only one good instead of trying to get multiple good ideas. For DARLING, we see that it reaches a utility of 0.52 against 0.64 for Proposed (no think), but has a lower distance (0.67 against 0.88). Showing that rewarding within-set generation for diversity is more effective than across-rollout diversity.
blocks.zh: 拟议培训办法超越了不同的相互竞争的目标 仅限质量的设定水平目标(仅限RL)的培训给出了良好的双赢率(43%),但会使设定崩溃. 它的平均距离下降到0.38. 这表明只有在一组中进行质量培训才能给我们带来好的想法,但模型最终只专注于一个好,而不是试图获得多个好的想法. 对于DARLING来说,我们看到它的效用是0.52,对于提议的0.64(没有想法),但距离较小(0.67对0.88)。 显示在设定内奖励多样性比推广多样性更为有效。

blocks.en: SFT keeps the model grounded To test the SFT warm-start, we train the same base model with our objective but skip SFT ( Impact+diversity, no SFT ). This baseline matches Proposed (think) at 0.51 CU, but does worse on grounding as seen in Figure 2 . Grounding for the no SFT baseline falls to g = 0.19 g=0.19 , against 0.81 with SFT (Figure 2 ). Without the warm-start, the policy gets its diversity by drifting away from its source documents. It also stays 0.13 CU below Proposed (no think). So SFT is what lets the set-level reward raise utility without losing grounding.
blocks.zh: SFT 将模型固定 为了测试 SFT 的温暖启动, 我们用我们的目标来训练同样的基模型, 但跳过 SFT( 影响+ 多样性, 没有 SFT ) 。 如图2所示,这一基线与拟议的0.51CU(想法)相符,但比按基准计算更为糟糕。 无SFT基线的基数为g=0.19g=0.19,而SFT为0.81(图2)。 没有热情的启动,政策就会从源文件上漂移,从而获得多样化. 它还将0.13CU保留在拟议(不考虑)之下。 因此,SFT是让设定级奖赏提高效用而不失去基础的方法.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Creative Utility (CU) against average grounding ( g g ) for the systems also mentioned in Table 1 . The highest-CU systems are less grounded than Claude and the SFT-only models.
blocks.zh: 图2:表1中也提及的系统的创造性功能(CU)相对于平均地基(gg) 最高的CU系统比克劳德和SFT唯一的型号更不扎实.

blocks.en: Thinking helps retain grounding Proposed (think) has lower utility than Proposed (no think) (0.51 vs. 0.64). Primary reason for this is a lower win rate (0.34 vs. 0.50), but we see that thinking gets more grounding (0.81 vs. 0.61; Figure 2 ). The grounding gap appears only after RL, since SFT-only think and no-think models are equally grounded (0.91 vs. 0.90). Thinking thus seems to help the policy retain grounding as RL pushes for utility. We hypothesize two reasons why thinking may not raise utility. First, the reward scores only the final ideas, and the impact signal is a judged comparison against a gold idea that cannot be verified at intermediate steps. Thus the steps might not have enough causal influence on the reward ( Sprague et al., 2025 ) . Second, designing thinking traces suitable for creative ideation is an open-problem. In our work, we tried one approach that was hindsight generation. While we instruct the teacher model to propose negatives, verify etc. there may be instances where there is no ‘search’ for candidates beyond what the model generated originally; we also tried distilling forward-thinking traces but it showed the same trend (Appendix E ). We leave the problem of designing synthetic or appropriate thinking traces for creative/open-ended problems to future work.
blocks.zh: 思考有助于保持拟议(思考)的效用低于拟议(思考)(0.51对0.64)。 造成这种情况的主要原因是胜率较低(0.34对0.50),但我们看到,思维会更加根基(0.81对0.61;图2)。 落地差距只出现在RL之后,因为只有SFT的思维模式和无思维模式是同样被基于的(0.91对0.90). 因此,思考似乎有助于保持政策的基础,因为RL推动效用。 我们假设两个原因 思考可能不会增加效用。 首先,奖励只给最终想法打分,而撞击信号则是与无法在中间步骤中验证的黄金想法进行判断性比较. 因此,这些步骤可能对奖励产生足够的因果关系(Sprague等人,2025年)。 其次,设计适合创造性想法的思维痕迹是一个开放的问题. 在我们的工作中,我们尝试了一种是后世的方法。 当我们指示老师模型 提出负面,验证等。 可能存在一些对候选人没有“搜索”的情况, 我们把为创造性/开放式问题设计合成或适当思维痕迹的问题留给今后的工作。

blocks.en: Table 2: GiantsBench results on 2,374 test papers.
blocks.zh: 表2:巨人奔驰在2,374份测试论文上的结果.

blocks.en: We beat Giants-4B on GiantsBench Table 2 shows the length-controlled win-rate and the average distance on GiantsBench. Our model achieves a win-rate of 68.3% against the gold idea, compared to 18.3% for GIANTS-4B. We want to note that GIANTS was trained on a ‘similarity’ to gold-idea metric, which does not lead to the model generating ideas better than the gold idea (18.3% win rate) and also leads to collapse of ideas. GIANTS-4B’s average pairwise distance is 0.025, against 0.939 for ours, since sampling it three times yields near-identical restatements of the same insight.
blocks.zh: 我们在巨人奔驰上击败巨人4B Table 2显示巨人奔驰上长度控制的胜率和平均距离. 我们的模式实现了68.3%的胜利率,而GIANTS-4B的胜利率为18.3%。 我们想指出的是,GIANTS接受过“同源性”到黄金理想的衡量标准的培训,这不会导致模型产生比黄金思想更好的想法(18.3%),也会导致思想崩溃。 GIANTS-4B的平均对比距离为0.025, 而我们的对比为0. 939, 因为采样率是同一见解的近乎相同的重复。

blocks.en:
Table 3: Taxonomy diversity on IdeaSeed (500x3 ideas), Method Paradigm
axis.
blocks.zh:
表3:关于思想种子的分类多样性(500x3想法),方法范式
轴。

blocks.en: IdeaSeed: quality gains without type collapse In Table 3 , we report population level entropy metrics on the ‘method’ axis. Every model is more concentrated than human proposals ( H norm = 0.87 H_{\mathrm{norm}}=0.87 ). We see that after training, our models do not collapse at the population level. Proposed (think) reaches 0.73 0.73 (TVD 0.30 0.30 ), close to Claude Opus 4.8 and Qwen3-8B ( 0.77 0.77 ), while Proposed (no think) is lower at 0.65 0.65 (TVD 0.43 0.43 ). The prompted baselines are somewhat ahead of us on this axis, which suggests RL may have cost some population level type diversity, though our thinking proposal recovers much of it. Since our objective targets diversity within each set and does not directly optimize the spread of idea types across instances, improving population-level diversity is an open direction for future work. DARLING on the other hand collapses onto a single Evidence Gap / Empirical Mapping pair. Results on the Opportunity axis and the per-label distributions are in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 思想种子:没有类型崩溃的质量收益 在表3中,我们在 " 方法 " 轴上报告人口水平的py度量。 每个模型都比人类提案更集中(H规范=0.87 H_{\mathrm{norm}}=0.87). 我们认为,经过培训后,我们的模式不会在人口一级崩溃。 拟议的(思想)达到0.73 0.73 (TVD 0.30 0.30 ),接近克劳德·奥普斯4.8和Qune3-8B (0.77 0.77 ),而拟议的(没有思想)低于0.65 0.65 (TVD 0.43 0.43 0.43 ). 在这个轴线上,所触发的基线略高于我们,这表明RL可能花费了某种人口层次的多样性,尽管我们的思考建议恢复了大部分。 由于我们的目标针对每一组中的多样性,并没有直接优化概念类型在各种情况下的传播,改善人口层面的多样性是未来工作的开放方向。 另一方面,DARLING会倒塌到一个单一的证据缺口/经验映射对上。 关于机会轴和每个标签分配的结果载于附录E。

blocks.en: Appendix E reports how the proposed recipe generalizes to a different model family, per-domain results, and how win rate and diversity change with idea position.
blocks.zh: 附 录 E报告拟议的食谱如何概括到不同的模式家庭,每个领域的结果,以及赢率和多样性如何随想法位置而变化。

blocks.en: 6 Downstream Validation of Idea Sets
blocks.zh: 6 思想集的下游验证

blocks.en: To validate that the ideas generated by our model are actually promising for researchers, we conduct two experiments: (a) human study with domain experts and, (b) execution-based evaluation using coding agents.
blocks.zh: 为了证实我们的模型所产生的想法对研究人员来说实际上很有希望,我们进行了两项实验:(a) 与域专家一起进行人类研究;(b) 使用编码剂进行基于执行的评价。

blocks.en: 6.1 Human Study: Portfolio Quality and Diversity
blocks.zh: 6.1 人类研究:组合质量和多样性

blocks.en: We conduct a pilot user study to evaluate if the ideas are usable, promising and unique to humans. To recruit users, we set a minimum criterion that they have a PhD in the field of NLP and at least four published academic papers in top-tier conferences. We onboard four participants for the task, that meet our established criteria. Each user gives us a preference for the topics within NLP/ML they are comfortable with (self-declared expertise), and we match them with a subset of queries from our test set that fall under those topics. Each user gets assigned 15 instances and they blind evaluate sets of ideas from three systems: Claude Opus 4.8, Qwen3-8B and our Proposed (no think) model. Overall, each user gives judgments on 45 sets of ideas.
blocks.zh: 我们进行了试点用户研究,以评估这些想法是否可用、是否有希望和对人类是否独特。 为了招聘用户,我们设定了一个最低标准,即他们拥有NLP领域的博士学位,并在顶级会议上至少发表四篇学术论文. 我们为这项任务派出了四名参加者,他们符合我们既定的标准。 每个用户都偏爱NLP/ML中他们自在的话题(自述的专业知识), 每个用户被分配到15个实例,他们盲目地评价三个系统中的一组想法: Claude Opus 4.8, Qune3-8B和我们提议的(不思考)模式. 总体而言,每个用户对45套想法作出判断。

blocks.en: For each set of ideas, our experts make three judgments: (1) which ideas are worth pursuing as early-stage research directions ( promising ); (2) ignoring quality, the largest subset of ideas that pursue substantively different directions ( unique ); and (3) the same subset, restricted to ideas marked worth pursuing ( Unique Promising ). Two ideas count as the same direction when carrying out one would largely address the other. Generally, a higher score is better for all these metrics.
blocks.zh: 对于每一套想法,我们的专家都作出三个判断:(1) 作为早期研究方向(有希望)值得追求哪些想法;(2) 忽略质量,即追求实质性不同方向(唯一)的最大想法的子集;(3) 相同的子集,仅限于值得追求的理念(唯一希望)。 在执行其中一项时,有两个想法是同一个方向,基本上涉及另一个方向。 一般来说,对所有这些衡量标准来说,较高的分数更好。

blocks.en: Table 4: Human study results with 4 annotators, 15 papers each. We see our proposed model generates ideas that are as promising and diverse as Claude-Opus-4.8. Proposed is significantly better than Qwen3-8B on all three metrics.
blocks.zh: 表4:人类研究的结果,4位注释员,每位论文15篇. 我们认为,我们提议的模式产生的想法与克劳德-奥普斯-4.8一样充满希望和多样性。 在所有三个度量标准上,提议大大优于Qune3-8B。

blocks.en: Table 4 reports aggregate judgments across 4 annotators and 60 instances. Our model’s portfolios contain 2.17 promising ideas and 2.83 unique ideas on average, against 2.20 and 2.72 for Claude Opus 4.8 and 1.52 and 2.52 for Qwen3-8B. Combining these, we see that our proposed model and Claude Opus 4.8 are considered similarly promising. Appendix E breaks these results down by topics of the target paper and users.
blocks.zh: 表4报告4个注释员和60个案例的合并判决。 我们的模型组合平均包含2.17个有希望的想法和2.83个独特的想法,而克劳德·奥普斯4.8和Qune3-8B的2.20和2.72则包含1.52和2.52。 结合这些,我们看到,我们提议的模式和克劳德·奥普斯4.8也被认为具有类似的希望。 附 录 E按目标文件的主题和用户细分了这些结果.

blocks.en: 6.2 Can ideas be executed?
blocks.zh: 6.2 (中文(简体) ). 想法可以执行吗?

blocks.en: Having established the quality and diversity of ideas in the previous sections, we check if the generated ideas hold up when carried towards execution. This is like a held-out quality check for the model trained on the impact signal. To test this, we take 15 instances and execute sets of 3 ideas from Claude Opus 4.8 and our no-think and think models. Every idea frozen into a card independently with the source hidden and handed to a Claude Code agent (Claude Opus 5) in a fixed sandbox with a 90-minute, $30 budget and no GPU, identical for every idea. The agent designs and runs a proof-of-concept test for early signal on the claim, then self-reports one verdict: supports , refutes or, inconclusive . Supports requires a positive result covering most or all of the claim.
blocks.zh: 在前几节确定了想法的质量和多样性之后,我们检查所产生的想法在付诸执行时是否仍然有效。 这就像对受过撞击信号训练的模型进行质量检查。 为了检验这一点,我们用15个例子 执行克劳德·奥普斯4.8的3个想法 以及我们的无思维模式 每一个想法都与源头隐藏独立冻结成一张卡片,并交给一个克劳德密码代理(Claude Opus 5)在一个固定的沙盒里,预算90分钟,30美元,没有GPU,每个想法都是一样的. 代理设计并运行一个概念验证测试, 早期在索赔的信号, 然后自我报告一个判决:支持、反驳或无结论。 支持要求获得涵盖大部分或所有索赔的积极成果。

blocks.en: Table 5: Execution results of 132 ideas by a coding agent.
blocks.zh: 表5:一个编码机构对132个想法的执行结果。

blocks.en: Table 5 reports success@ k k . For k = 3 k=3 it is the fraction of instances (15; 14 for think) for which at least one of the 3 ideas from a system gets a supports verdict from the agent. For k < 3 k<3 we average that indicator over all size- k k subsets of the instance’s 3 ideas, then over instances. Our models are comparable to Claude Opus 4.8 at every k k . We find no evidence of a quality loss relative to Claude Opus 4.8. All success rates increase with k k , so a set of ideas is more useful than a single one.
blocks.zh: 表5报告成功@kk. 对于k = 3 k = 3,是实例(15;思考14)的一小部分,其中一个系统中的3个想法中至少有1个得到代理商的支持判断. 对 k < 3 k < 3, 我们平均该指标在所有大小上 -- k k 子集 实例中的3个概念, 然后是实例。 我们的型号可以和克劳德·奥普斯4.8 相媲美 我们没有发现与Claude Opus 4.8相关的质量损失的证据。 所有成功率随着k k 的提高而增加,所以一套想法比单一的想法更有用.

blocks.en:
What a run looks like. Given a frozen card, the agent first turns the claim’s properties into concrete measurements: it picks datasets, controls and thresholds. It then runs a first proof of concept, and revises the plan after seeing its own results. In the example in Appendix F , we show a memory-benchmark idea from the think model. The first run showed that one planned probe could not support the claim’s
“shared failure” conjunct. The agent replaced the probe with three pre-registered ones and fixed its decision rules before running them. The final verdict is supports . A qualitative read of this run suggests the verdict is somewhat stronger than the evidence in places (Appendix F ), so we treat verdicts as early signals for a researcher to follow up rather than as findings. Table 18 shows additional examples of claims, verdicts along with the initial plan tried by the coding agent.
blocks.zh:
跑步的样子 鉴于一张被冻结的卡片,代理商首先将索赔的属性转化为具体测量:它选择数据集、控制和阈值。 之后它运行了第一个概念证明,并在看到自己的结果后修改计划. 在附录F的例子中,我们从思维模型中展示了一个记忆基准思想. 第一次运行表明,一个计划中的探测器不能支持索赔。
“共同失败”连结。 特工用3个预先注册的探测器取代了探测器,并在运行前确定了其决定规则. 最终判决支持. 从质的角度来看,判决比地方上的证据(Appendix F)要强一些,因此我们把判决作为研究者跟进的早期信号,而不是调查结果。 表18列出了其他索赔、判决和编码代理人所审理的初步计划的例子。

blocks.en: 7 Related Work
blocks.zh: 7 相关工作

blocks.en: A large body of work has quantified the quality-diversity trade-off in LLMs, across creative writing, open-ended generation, and idea generation ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Shypula et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Wadhwa et al., 2026 ; Padmakumar and He, 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) . A common finding is that RL and preference tuning collapse the policy onto a few modes, trading diversity for quality ( Kirk et al., 2024 ; Cui et al., 2025 ) . Training-time fixes reward diversity across independent rollouts of a prompt ( Li et al., 2025 ) , or, in preference optimization, select diverse preference pairs ( Lanchantin et al., 2026 ) . More recent work rewards a set of outputs directly, either to cover a verifiable answer set ( Puri et al., 2026 ) or to trade off a fixed reward vector ( Bahlous-Boldi et al., 2026 ) . All of these need an answer set or a fixed reward space to define coverage. In open-ended ideation neither exists, since whether two ideas are distinct is itself a judgment made in the context of the others in the set. Our objective addresses this by scoring each idea against the ones already written in the same generation.
blocks.zh: 大量工作已经量化了LLMs的质量多样性权衡,跨越了创造性的写作、开放的一代和思想的产生(Zhang等人,2025年;Shypula等人,2025年;Chen等人,2026年;Wadhwa等人,2026年;Padmakumar和He,2024年;Jiang等人,2025年)。 一个常见的发现是,RL和优惠调整政策会崩溃到几种模式上,将多样性交易到质量上(Kirk等人,2024年;Cui等人,2025年)。 培训时间将奖励多样性确定为独立推出的及时性(Li等人,2025年),或在优化优惠时选择不同的优先对(Lanchantin等人,2026年)。 最近的工作直接奖励一套产出,要么涵盖可核查的答案(Puri等人,2026年),要么交易固定的奖励矢量(Bahlous-Boldi等人,2026年)。 所有这些都需要一个答案集或固定的奖励空间来定义覆盖范围. 在无限制的想法中,两者都不存在,因为两个想法是否不同,这本身就是在一组其他想法的背景下作出的判断。 我们的目标是通过将每个想法与同一代人已经写出来的想法相提并论来解决这个问题。

blocks.en: Literature-grounded ideation systems generally start from a small seed and build ideas outward from it. SciMON ( Wang et al., 2024 ) revises an idea until it is sufficiently novel relative to prior papers, ResearchAgent ( Baek et al., 2025 ) refines a proposal through rounds of reviewer feedback, and Nova generates hundreds of candidates from a seed paper and clusters them to select a diverse final set ( Hu et al., 2025 ) . Revision, critique, and clustering are all ways to obtain diversity, but they act after generation on candidates written without regard to one another, and the generator is never trained to write ideas that differ from each other. On the other hand, GIANTS ( He-Yueya et al., 2026 ) trains a model with RL to anticipate a downstream paper’s core insight from its parent papers, and Tong et al. (2026) train a judge and an ideator on community feedback such as citations, both rewarding one idea at a time.
blocks.zh: 以文学为基础的思想体系一般是从一个小种子开始的,并且从这个种子中培养出思想. SciMON(Wang et al., 2024)修改了一个想法,直到它相对于之前的论文足够新颖为止,ResearchAgent(Baek et al., 2025)通过几轮评论员反馈来完善一个提案,Nova从种子纸中产生数百名候选人,并将其分组来选择一个多样化的最终组合(Hu et al., 2025). 修订、批评和集群是获得多样性的各种方式,但它们在一代又一代地对不考虑彼此写作的候选人采取行动,而生成者从未受过写作不同想法的培训。 另一方面,GIANTS(He-Yueya et al., 2026)用RL来训练一个模型,从母论文中预示下游纸的核心洞察力,Tong et al. (2026年)培训一名法官和一名思想家学习社区反馈,如引用,两者同时奖励一个想法.

blocks.en: A separate line grounds ideation in execution, using the outcomes of implementing and running ideas as the reward. Si et al. (2026) find that reinforcement learning from execution signal suffers from mode collapse: the model raises its average reward by converging on a few simple ideas. Because each idea is rewarded in isolation, nothing discourages repeating the same safe idea. We differ on both axes. Our input is a whole body of documents instead of a single seed, and the model writes a set of ideas in one generation, trained on a reward in which each idea is scored against the ones already written. We also use execution as an evaluation, checking whether sets of ideas succeed downstream (Section 6.2 ).
blocks.zh: 以执行和运行思想的结果作为奖励,单独提出执行中的一行思路。 Si等人(2026年)发现,从执行信号中学习强化会遇到模式崩溃的困扰:该模式通过在几个简单想法上趋同来提高平均回报. 因为每个想法都是孤立地得到回报的,所以没有什么能阻止重复同样的安全想法. 在两轴问题上,我们意见不一。 我们的投入是一整批文件,而不是单一的种子,模型在一代人的时间里写出一套想法,经过训练的奖励,在每个想法中与已经写出来的那些想法打分. 我们还将执行作为一种评价,检查下游的一套想法是否成功(第6.2节)。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We present a set-level RL objective for document-grounded ideation for training to generate diverse, high quality ideas. A model is prompted/taught to generate K K ideas in one rollout and each idea’s quality is weighted by its distance from the ideas before it. Our best 8B model (no think) achieves higher creative utility than strong closed-source models and competing quality-diversity objectives, while the think variant beats the closed-source models and is on par with DARLING. In small pilot human and execution studies its sets are comparable to Claude Opus 4.8’s, so we see no evidence that diversity costs quality. Future work includes grounding-aware rewards, diversity across a population, and reasoning traces designed for creative ideation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个基于文件的关于培训的构想的固定的RL目标,以产生各种高质量的构想。 一个模型在一次推出中产生K思想, 我们最好的8B模型(没有想法)比强大的闭源模型和竞争的质量多样性目标实现更高的创造性效用,而思维变体则比闭源模型强,与DARLING相当. 在小型人文和执行实验研究中,它的套件与克劳德·奥普斯4.8的套件相当,因此我们没有看到多样性需要质量的证据。 未来的工作包括基于认识的奖励、人口的多样性和为创造性思想设计的推理痕迹。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our study currently focuses on scientific ideation based on context and parametric knowledge, instead of focusing on retrieval. This is partially because we are testing the set up of training with a new set style generation where the aim is to increase diversity while also improving the quality. In future work we aim to include retrieval in this ideation process. We also train on english only, natural language processing scientific papers.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究目前侧重于基于上下文和参数化知识的科学设想,而不是侧重于检索。 其部分原因是我们正在测试培训的设置,采用新的设计风格,目的是增加多样性,同时提高质量。 在今后的工作中,我们的目标是将检索纳入这一设想过程。 我们还只学习英语,自然语言处理科学论文。

blocks.en: AI Use Statement
blocks.zh: AI 使用语句

blocks.en: The training data for our proposed method was generated using AI. We used Claude Opus-4.8 for it. In addition, code written with generative AI was used to conduct and carry out the analyses here. However, the research hypotheses in this work and the design of the experiments were both human-originated. AI tools were used for assistance with revisions, but not for writing in a substantive way. The authors take responsibility for the final content of this work.
blocks.zh: 我们拟议方法的培训数据是使用AI生成的。 我们用克劳德·奥普斯 -4.8做这个 此外,还使用带有基因AI的代码来进行和进行这里的分析. 然而,这项工作中的研究假设和实验的设计都是由人类产生的。 人工智能工具用于协助修订,但不用于实质性写作。 作者对本作品的最后内容负责.

blocks.en: Appendix A Dataset
blocks.zh: 附录A 数据集

blocks.en: A.1 Data Format
blocks.zh: A.1 数据格式

blocks.en: In this Section we explain different aspects of the data curation process, including document acquisition, formats etc.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们解释数据整理过程的不同方面,包括文件获取、格式等。

blocks.en: Each idea the model generates is a JSON object in the four-field schema of Section 3 . This includes: ( problem_gap , core_claim , method , inspiration ). The definitions of the four fields are given below (as per the inference prompt): • problem gap : The gap the idea addresses, drawn from across the source documents – an open question, tension, or unresolved difficulty that connects them and that none resolves on its own. State it as one clear gap, NOT as your specific solution to it. BEGIN this field with the single best-fitting OPPORTUNITY PATTERN label in square brackets (from the taxonomy below), then the prose gap (1 to 2 sentences). Pick the ONE dominant pattern even if several apply; if NONE genuinely fits, use “[Other]” rather than forcing a poor match. Example: “[Bridge Opportunity] Work on X and on Y each..but neither connects..”. • core claim : The couple of sentences the whole idea lives or dies on – “we claim that X.” It must be something that could turn out to be wrong: a definite, testable assertion / hypothesis / insight, not a topic or a direction. Do not just restate the gap, and do not describe what you would do about it. From these sentences alone a reader should know exactly what the idea is betting on (1-2 sentences). • method : At a high level, how the claim would be turned into research – the kind of move (combining ideas, extending to a new setting, deriving formally, building an artifact, etc.) and how it addresses the gap. A proposed approach, not a step-by-step protocol. Begins with one bracketed Method Paradigm label. • inspiration : Three to five sentences arguing how the idea arises FROM the source documents – the relationship between them, not a per-document restatement. Must (1) name each cited source’s limitation and (2) justify why connecting them is a non-obvious leap. Refers to sources by their numbered ‘Document N’ label.

blocks.en: A.2 Data Curation: Gathering Documents
blocks.zh: A.2 数据校正:收集文档

blocks.en: We describe the dataset construction in detail in this section. As mentioned in Section 3.2 , our dataset curation has two steps: (a) gathering the documents (b) putting together the SFT dataset. In this subsection we discuss the gathering documents.
blocks.zh: 我们在本节中详细描述了数据集构造。 如第3.2节所述,我们的数据集目录有两个步骤:(a) 收集文件(b) 汇总SFT数据集。 在这个小节中,我们讨论集会文件。

blocks.en: Each instance in our dataset has a target or gold idea which is derived from a published paper. For each gold idea, we also store a subset of its references that we consider as “core” to its generation. These references are inputs to our proposed method. We use the GiantsBench ( He-Yueya et al., 2026 ) training split to get the target paper ids. We detail the generation process and each of the steps below.
blocks.zh: 我们数据集的每一个实例都有一个目标或金色的构想,这个构想来源于一份已发表的论文。 对于每一个黄金想法,我们也存有它的一个子集,我们认为它是这一代人的“核心”。 这些提法是对我们拟议方法的投入。 我们使用Giants Bench(He-Yueya等人,2026年)的训练分裂来获得目标纸上的ID. 我们详细介绍了生成过程和以下每个步骤。

blocks.en: For every target ID we proceed through the following stages: 1. Target full text. We fetch the target’s arXiv HTML (falling back to ar5iv for older papers) and parse it into { title, abstract, sections, tables, references, full text }. 2. Reference edges. We pull the target’s full reference list as structured edges from the Semantic Scholar API ( Kinney et al., 2023 ) , with per-edge citation intents, an isInfluential flag, and the cited paper’s metadata (title, abstract, year, venue, open-access PDF link). 3. Importance classification. An LLM ( claude-sonnet-4-6 ) reads the target’s title, abstract, and body once, together with every reference and all of its collected mention snippets, and decides which references are sources i.e. the small subset that motivated the paper, exposed a gap it targets, supplied its conceptual foundation, or is directly extended. We get this classification from prior work done on citation importance ( Cohan et al., 2019 ) . A reference can be a source or an other . Each source receives one or more of four labels ( motivates , exposes_gap , foundation , extends ), a short rationale, and verbatim supporting quotes. The full prompt is given in Prompt G . 4. Reference full text. For every source reference, we get the paper text through the process described in Step 1. 5. Summarization. We summarize the target and source documents using the idea card format in Appendix A.1 . For the source documents, we add two additional fields i.e. results and takeaways . The target’s own contribution is extracted separately as a gold idea used only inside the reward (the impact comparison, Section 3.1 ) and is never shown to the policy. 6. Consolidation. We drop targets with two or fewer source documents or no gold idea, and then join everything into one record per target. The source references become the input, and the target paper becomes the gold document.
blocks.zh: 对于每个目标ID,我们进行以下阶段: 1. 目标全文。 我们获取目标 arXiv HTML( 旧文件回落到 ar5iv ) 并将其解析为{标题、抽象、章节、表格、参考资料、全文}。 2. 参考边缘。 我们从语义学者API(Kinney et al., 2023)中抽取目标的全部参考清单, 3. 重要性分类。 LLM(claude-sonnet-4-6 ) 读过目标的标题,抽象,和身体一次,连同每一个参考及其收集的所有引用片段,并决定哪些参考物是源头,即激发论文的小型子集,暴露其目标缺口,提供其概念基础,或直接扩展. 我们从先前关于引用重要性的工作中获得这一分类(Cohan等人,2019年)。 参考文献可以是来源,也可以是其他来源。 每个来源收到四个标签中的一个或多个(动机 , 暴露_gap, 基础 , 扩展 ) , 一个简短的理由, 以及逐字记录支持引用 。 全部提示在 Expoint G 中给出。 4. 参考全文。 对于每个来源,我们通过步骤1所述过程获得文件文本。 5. 总结。 我们使用附录A.1中的思想卡格式来总结目标和源文件。 对于源文件,我们增加两个额外的字段,即结果和外卖。 目标本身的贡献作为黄金思想单独提取,仅用于奖励(影响比较,第3.1节),从未向政策显示。 6. 合并。 我们用两个或更少的源文件或没有黄金想法来投放目标,然后将一切合并成每个目标的一个记录. 来源引用成为输入,目标纸张成为黄金文档.

blocks.en: A.3 Training Data Curation
blocks.zh: A.3 培训数据校验

blocks.en: As briefly discussed in Section 3.2 , we use hindsight prompting to generate SFT data with thinking traces. Having collected the documents/instances from the steps in Appendix A.2 , we now build that into a training step. Since our training pipeline has two phases: (a) SFT and (b) GRPO, we first talk about the SFT dataset and the RL training follows from that.
blocks.zh: 正如第3.2节所简要讨论的那样,我们利用事后提示生成带有思维痕迹的SFT数据。 在从附录A.2的步骤中收集文件/资料之后,我们现在将此作为培训步骤。 由于我们的培训程序有两个阶段:(a) SFT和(b) GRPO,我们首先讨论SFT数据集,然后进行RL培训。

blocks.en: The SFT data curation process has two steps: (a) Generating K K ideas from a strong LLM (b) Generating thinking traces for the K K ideas. We use claude-opus-4.8 as the teacher model. We first prompt it with Prompt G to generate 3 ideas per instance. Then we use the Prompt G to generate the thinking trace in hindsight. Example G shows an example generated with the above pipeline. We see instances of the model exploring its own context, verifying its candidates, making them more concrete, making sure the ideas are not similar or the tags are correct etc.

blocks.zh: 附录B 培训详情

blocks.en: The same template is used to build both the live-inference user turn and the training input, so the model sees an identical instruction shape at train and test time. {num_ideas} is substituted with K K (3 in the main runs) and {documents} with the numbered source-document block of Appendix A.1 .

blocks.en: Along with Equation 2 we have two terms that the training reward adds around the set-level score to make it operational.
blocks.zh: 与方程式2,我们有两个条件 训练奖励附加 围绕设定的分数 使它运行。

blocks.en: Schema gate and bonus. A rollout is schema-valid only if it contains both a <think> and an <answer> block, the answer parses into exactly K K idea cards, every card has all four fields non-empty, and the problem_gap and method fields open with a valid taxonomy label. An invalid rollout receives reward 0 0 and no judge is called. A valid rollout additionally receives a small bonus ϵ = 0.05 \epsilon=0.05 on top of the set score.
blocks.zh: 司马门和奖金. 只有同时包含一个<思考>和一个<回答>块,答案才具有计划验证性,答案将完全切入K K 创意卡,每张卡都有所有四个字段不空,问题_gap和方法字段会打开一个有效的分类标签. 无效的推出获得0奖赏,没有法官被调用. 有效的推出附加获得小分奖金 = 0.05\epsilon= 0.05 在设定分数之上.

blocks.en: Length penalty. To keep RL from lengthening the cards to raise the judged impact, we subtract a one-sided, dead-banded, capped penalty. Let L L be the number of Qwen3 tokens in the concatenated problem_gap , core_claim , and method fields of the K K cards, i.e. exactly the text the quality and distance judges read. The inspiration field and the <think> block are not measured, so trimming grounding cannot avoid the penalty. With target length L 0 L_{0} , tolerance τ \tau , slope λ \lambda , and cap c c , pen ​ ( L ) = λ ⋅ min ⁡ ( max ⁡ ( 0 , L / L 0 − ( 1 + τ ) ) , c ) . \text{pen}(L)=\lambda\cdot\min\!\Big(\max\big(0,\ L/L_{0}-(1+\tau)\big),\ c\Big). (6) We use L 0 = 1,000 L_{0}=1{,}000 , τ = 0 \tau=0 , λ = 1 \lambda=1 , and c = 3 c=3 , so no penalty applies below 1,000 1{,}000 tokens and the penalty never exceeds λ ​ c = 3 \lambda c=3 (reached at 4,000 4{,}000 tokens). blocks.en: B.3 DARLING
blocks.zh: B.3 拆卸

blocks.en: DARLING ( Li et al., 2025 ) optimizes quality and diversity across the rollouts of one prompt, whereas our reward enforces diversity within a single generated set. We re-implement it in our setting so that the only intended difference from our method is where diversity is enforced. We keep DARLING’s group-partition diversity term and its multiplicative reward, and we replace its learned equivalence classifier and quality reward with the judges used elsewhere in this paper.
blocks.zh: DARLING(Li等人,2025年)在推出一个提示时优化了质量和多样性,而我们的奖励则在单一生成的组合中强化多样性。 我们在我们的环境下重新执行它,以便与我们的方法的唯一预期区别是多样性的落实。 我们保留了DARLING团体多样性的术语及其多重奖励,我们用本文其他部分所用的法官取代其学到的等同分类和质量奖励。

blocks.en: Setup (no SFT). DARLING is trained with K = 1 K{=}1 : each rollout is a single idea card, and the group of rollouts for a prompt provides the diversity signal. Following their recipe, we start GRPO directly from Qwen3-8B, with no SFT warm-start. The model therefore learns the card format only from the schema check in the reward and from the prompt (identical to Appendix B ). This matches the original method, which also applies RL to an instruction-tuned model without a task-specific SFT stage. The training instances, prompt, and judges are the same as for our method.
blocks.zh: 设置(无SFT). DARLING以K=1KQQ1进行训练:每次推出都是一个单一的创意卡,推出一个即时的组合提供多样性信号. 根据他们的食谱,我们直接从Quen3-8B开始GRPO,没有SFT的温暖启动. 因此,该模型只从奖励中的计划检查和即时(与附录B相同)中学习卡片格式。 这与原始方法相匹配,这种方法也将RL应用于没有任务特定SFT阶段的指令调制模型. 培训事例,即时和法官,与我们的方法相同。

blocks.en: Reward. For a group of n = 8 n{=}8 rollouts { y 1 , … , y n } \{y_{1},\dots,y_{n}\} for the same prompt, the reward of rollout i i is r i = q ⁡ ( y i ) ⋅ div i , div i = max ⁡ ( 0.1 , n − | C ⁡ ( i ) | n − 1 ) , r_{i}=q(y_{i})\cdot\mathrm{div}_{i},\qquad\mathrm{div}_{i}=\max\!\Big(0.1,\ \frac{n-|C(i)|}{n-1}\Big), (8) where q ⁡ ( y i ) q(y_{i}) is the same pairwise impact win against the gold idea as in Appendix C.1 (SciJudge-30B), and C ⁡ ( i ) C(i) is the cluster containing i i . Clusters come from union-find over a pairwise equivalence test, as in DARLING’s released code. Two rollouts are merged if the distance between their ideas is below a threshold of 0.5. Instead of DARLING’s trained Qwen3-Embedding classifier, we test equivalence with our distance judge ( gpt-oss-120b , Appendix C ). A rollout in a large group of near-duplicates therefore gets a low diversity score, and a unique rollout gets a score close to 1. With K = 1 K{=}1 there is one idea per rollout, so no set-level aggregation is needed. An invalid rollout receives reward 0.

Big(0, 1,\\ frac{n-|C(i)|}{n-1}\Big), (8) 其中q ⁡(yi) q(y_{i}) 与附录C.1(Scijudge-30B)中相同的双向撞击战胜黄金理念,而C ⁡(i) C(i)是包含i i的集群. 组群来自一个双向等效测试, 如果它们的思想之间的距离低于0.5的阈值,则两个推出合并. 而不是DARLING训练有素的Quen3-Embedding分类器, 我们测试与距离裁判的等效性(gpt-oss-120b,附录C)。 因此,在一大批近似重复的作品中推出,获得较低的多样性分数,独特的推出则获得接近1的分数. 随着K=1KQQ1的推出,每次推出都有一个想法,所以不需要设置级别汇总. 无效推出获得0分奖励.

blocks.en: Optimization. We follow DARLING’s recipe: n = 8 n{=}8 rollouts per prompt, 12 prompts per step, advantages without standard-deviation normalization, symmetric PPO clipping at 0.2, no entropy bonus, KL coefficient 0.001, learning rate 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6} , and rollout temperature 1.0 for training and validation.
blocks.zh: 优化. 我们遵循DARLING的配方:n = 8 n = ox 8 每步12 个提示, 没有标准调整正常化的优势, 对称 PPO 剪辑为 0.2 , 无py奖, KL 系数 0. 00, 学习速率 1× 10 = 6 1\ = 10 = 6 = 6 ) , 并推出温度 1.0 用于培训和验证。

blocks.en: Evaluation. At test time we sample three independent generations per instance and treat them as the set, since the policy was trained to produce one idea per generation. All metrics in Section 5 are computed on this set with the same judges as for the other models.
blocks.zh: 评价。 在测试时,我们每例抽样三个独立世代,并把它们当作一组,因为政策是经过培训,每代产生一个想法的。 第5节中的所有衡量标准都用与其他模型相同的法官计算。

blocks.en: B.4 Olmo-3 Details
blocks.zh: B.4 奥尔莫-3

blocks.en: To test that the recipe is not specific to one model family, we repeat it on Olmo-3-7B ( Olmo et al., 2025 ) . We initialize from allenai/Olmo-3-7B-Think-SFT , and run the same SFT (with and without thinking) and GRPO settings as Table 7 . The length penalty is measured with the Olmo tokenizer. The two tokenizers count the card text within about 0.5 % 0.5\% , so L 0 L_{0} is unchanged. Results are in Appendix E (Transfer of recipe to other models).
blocks.zh: 为了检验食谱并非针对一个模范家庭,我们在Olmo-3-7B(Olmo等人,2025年)上重复一遍。 我们从 Alenai/Olmo-3-7B-Think-SFT 初始化,运行与表7相同的 SFT(有和没有思考)和GPRO 设置. 长度处罚用奥尔莫标致器来测量. 两种标注器将卡片文本计算在0.5%~0.5%以内,因此L 0 L_{0}没有变化. 结果载于附录E(向其他模式转移食谱)。

blocks.en: B.5 Compute
blocks.zh: B.5 计算

blocks.en: All runs use a single node with 8 NVIDIA H200 GPUs. SFT uses all 8 GPUs and takes about 46 minutes per epoch on 7,172 instances. For GRPO, 6 GPUs hold the policy and the vLLM rollouts, and 2 GPUs serve SciJudge-30B (tensor parallel size 2); the gpt-oss-120b distance judge is served through an external API and needs no local GPUs. A GRPO step takes about one minute, so one epoch (about 600 steps at 12 prompts per step) takes roughly 10 hours.
blocks.zh: 所有运行都使用一个带有8个NVIDIA H200 GPU的单一节点. SFT使用所有的8GPU,在7,172个实例中每个纪元需要约46分钟. 对于GRPO,6个GPU持有政策和vLLM推出,2个GPU服务于SciJudge-30B(tensor并行尺寸2);gpt-oss-120b距离判官通过外部API服务,不需要本地GPU. 一个GRPO步骤大约需要一分钟,所以一个纪元(约600步,每步12个速率)大约需要10小时.

blocks.en: Appendix C Metrics
blocks.zh: 附录C

blocks.en: In this section we describe the metrics: (a) quality i.e. impact, (b) distance, (c) grounding and (d) creative utility. We show the prompts along with examples.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们描述了衡量标准:(a) 质量,即影响;(b) 距离;(c) 搁浅;(d) 创造性效用。 我们把提示和例子一起显示。

blocks.en: C.1 Quality
blocks.zh: C.1 质量

blocks.en: We score the quality of an idea q ⁡ ( u ) q(u) via a pairwise reward model that compares a generated idea against the gold idea ( g g ) for the same source set and returns which one is likely to have higher scientific impact. The resulting win/loss is the impact term I ⁡ ( u ) I(u) of Section 3.1 . The judge is called with both orderings of the pair to cancel position bias ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) , and I ⁡ ( u ) I(u) is the fraction of orderings won ( ∈ { 0 , 0.5 , 1 } \in\{0,0.5,1\} ). Where if u u wins in both orderings, we reward it 1, if u u loses in both orderings we reward 0, and if u u wins in one and loses in the other, we call it a tie and reward 0.5.
blocks.zh: 我们通过一个双向奖励模型来评分一个想法 q Q(u) q(u) 的质量,该模型将生成的想法与同一源集的黄金想法(g)进行比较,并返回一个可能具有较高科学影响的源集。 由此产生的赢/亏是第3.1节I(u)I(u)的影响术语。 法官被叫来的是两对命令取消位置偏差(郑等人,2023年),而I QQ(u) I(u)是命令胜出的一小部分({{0,0.5,1}}\in\{0,0.5,1\}). 如果两个订单都赢,我们奖励它1,如果两个订单都输,我们奖励0,如果一个中赢,另一个中输,我们就称它为平局,奖励0.5.

blocks.en: Table 8: Impact-judge win-rate. † evaluation judge; ‡ training-reward judge.
blocks.zh: 表8: 影响法官胜诉率。 评估法官;培训奖励法官。

blocks.en: To avoid any length biases in the preferences, we report a length-controlled win rate, following Length-Controlled AlpacaEval ( Dubois et al., 2024 ) , computed after the fact without re-judging. We treat a strict win ( u ≻ g u\succ g in both orderings) as 1 1 and a tie or loss as 0 0 , and fit one logistic regression over all ideas from all models in the evaluation pool, judged on the same instances by the same model.
blocks.zh: 为了避免在优惠中出现任何长度偏差,我们报告一个长度控制的赢率,这是按照长度控制的AlpacaEval(Dubois等人,2024年)在不作重新判断的情况下,按照事实计算的。 我们把严格的胜负(u ≻  g g u su cc  g  g  g  g ))视为11,将平局或亏局视为0 0.

blocks.en: We validate the impact judge q q (Eq. 3 ) two ways: (i) validation against real-world papers (ii) robustness to length.
blocks.zh: 我们验证影响法官q q (Eq. 3 ) 两种方法:(一) 对照现实世界的论文验证 (二) 坚固到长度.

blocks.en: We draw from our training set, papers from 2022 and 2023 and form pairs the same calendar year (within four months, to remove the age-of-paper confound). We only keep pairs that differ in their citation ratio (which we get from Semantic Scholar). We filter for a citation ratio of 3 with absolute gap of at least 10 citations. To ensure the gap reflects meaningful use, we add an influential-citation gate (both papers’ influential-citation counts > 0 >0 , winner above loser by a margin ≥ 5 \geq 5 , we get this from Semantic Scholar). We rewrite each instance in the pair into idea-only summaries that reveal no results, metrics, or titles; the judge then compares ideas , and the higher-uptake paper is the gold winner. This yields 122 122 labeled pairs ( 244 244 papers). We ask the judge which idea is higher impact. For validation we only prompt the model once and report the strict win rate (no ties). On the idea-card format used throughout the paper, the evaluation judge GPT-5.4-mini picks the higher-impact idea 74 % 74\% of the time. The training-reward judge SciJudge-30B , scores 65 % 65\% (Table 8 ). Between Claude and GPT, we went ahead with the latter for cost reasons.
blocks.zh: 我们从我们的训练集、2022年和2023年的论文中抽取,并在同一个日历年(在四个月之内,消除纸龄混乱)形成对子。 我们只保留在引用率上有差异的对(我们从语义学者那里得到的). 我们过滤引用比例为3,绝对空白至少为10。 为了保证差距反映有意义的用途,我们增加了一个有影响力的引用门(两份论文的有影响力的引用数 > 0 > 0,胜者高于失败者5============================================================================================================================================================================================================================= 我们把每个案例都重写成只有思想的总结, 这产生了122对有标签的对(244 244份纸)。 我们问法官,哪个想法的影响更大。 为了验证,我们只提示模型一次,并报告严格的赢率(没有联系)。 在整篇论文使用的思想卡格式上,评价法官GPT-5.4-mini选择了74%的74%的74QQ时间的较高影响的想法. 培训奖励法官Sci Judge-30B的成绩为65%(表8)。 克劳德和GPT之间,我们先去后者 出于成本原因。

blocks.en: Because the reward is evaluated on every rollout during RL, its judge is queried orders of magnitude more often than the evaluation judge, which is applied once per test instance. We therefore optimize against a smaller, cheaper judge and reserve a stronger judge for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 由于奖励在RL的每次推出时都会受到评价,因此其法官比评审法官更经常地被问到数量级,而评审法官每一次试用一次。 因此,我们最优化地对待一个更小、更便宜的法官,并保留一个更强大的法官进行评价。

blocks.en: To rule out that the judge merely prefers longer ideas, we summarize each candidate idea down to the gold idea’s length (around 250 tokens) without changing its content and re-judge (Table 9 ). The candidate ideas come from assorted baselines and earlier training checkpoints, chosen to span short to highly verbose ideas so the test covers the regime where length bias would show. We poll around 2000 idea pairs. The win rates in Table 9 are raw strict win rates (the candidate wins in both orderings), not length-controlled. Shortening the ideas to the gold length does not lower the win rate; it raises it for all three judges (e.g. 0.253 to 0.284 for gpt-5.4-mini ), so the judges do not simply reward longer ideas. The win rate is nevertheless sensitive to length, which is why we also report a length-controlled win-rate.
blocks.zh: 为了排除法官只喜欢更长的想法,我们将每个候选人的想法归纳到黄金想法的长度(约250个符号),而不改变其内容和重新判断(表9)。 候选人的想法来自各种基线和较早的训练检查站,选择了短到极具动词性的想法,因此测试涵盖了长度偏差将显示的制度。 大约两千个想法 表9中的胜率是原始的严格胜率(候选人在两种订单中胜出),而不是长度控制. 将想法缩短到黄金长度并不能降低胜率;它提高了所有三名法官的胜率(如gpt-5.4-mini的0.253到0.284),因此法官们不会简单地奖励更长的构想. 然而,胜利率对长度很敏感,这就是为什么我们还报告长度控制的胜利率。

blocks.en: Inference parameters. Default judge model for training is SciJudge-30B ; temperature 0.0 0.0 (greedy), max output tokens 2048 2048 , top_p = 0.8 =0.8 , top_k = 20 =20 . For evaluation we use GPT-5.4-mini as the judge, with the same prompt and both orderings. We use the prompt mentioned in Prompt G for estimating impact.
blocks.zh: 推论参数. 训练的默认裁判模型是SciJudge-30B;温度0.00.0(greedy),最大输出符2048 2048,最高_p=0.8=0.8,最高_k=20=20. 为了评估,我们使用GPT-5.4-mini作为法官,同时发出同样的即时命令和命令。 我们利用Source G中提及的提示来估计影响。

blocks.en: Table 9: Impact-judge performance with length changes. † evaluation judge.
blocks.zh: 表9:长度变化的影响法官业绩。 评估法官。

blocks.en: C.2 Distance
blocks.zh: C.2 距离

blocks.en: We score the pairwise distance d ⁡ ( u i , u j ) d(u_{i},u_{j}) between two idea cards via an LLM judge that rates similarity, field by field, over the problem_gap , core_claim , and method fields (Section 3.1 , Eq. 4 ); the inspiration field is excluded since it carries grounding rather than content.
blocks.zh: 我们通过一个LLM 判断器, 对相似度、 字段、 问题、 核心、 要求、 方法字段进行评分(第3.1节, Eq. 4),

blocks.en: From similarity to distance. Each 1-5 similarity is inverted to a per-field distance d field = ( 5 − sim ) / 4 ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] d_{\text{field}}=(5-\text{sim})/4\in[0,1] , and the three fields are averaged with equal weight (each 1 / 3 1/3 ) to give the pairwise distance d ⁡ ( u i , u j ) d(u_{i},u_{j}) used in Eq. 4 .
blocks.zh: 从相似至远. 每1~5个相似度被反转到一个每战区距离 d 字段= (5 − sim ) / 4 → [0, 1] d = text{ field → (5-\text { sim })/4\ in [0, 1], 三个字段平均重量相等(每个字段1 / 3 1/ 3),以给出 Eq 4 中使用的对比距离 d → (u i, u j ) d → (u i, u i), u j 。

blocks.en: We draw within-set idea pairs across a few different systems, so the pairs span a range of similarities the reward is supposed to see. Each pair is presented with the same idea format and every rater scores all three fields with the identical scoring rubric. Two annotators (also authors on the paper), independently score 100 pairs. We then run the LLM judges on the same pairs through the same prompt. In Table 10 , we report the human annotator agreement as well as agreement with the LLM as a judge. Humans achieve a moderate agreement of around 0.36 (Spearman). The training-reward judge i.e. gpt-oss-120b matches the human-human ceiling on the aggregated distance ( ρ = 0.37 \rho{=}0.37 vs. a human–human ρ = 0.36 \rho{=}0.36 ), so the reward reproduces the human ordering of idea pairs about as well as a second annotator does. The stronger reference judge which is used for the final evaluation i.e. gemini-3.5-flash , agrees more closely ( ρ = 0.50 \rho{=}0.50 on d d ).

blocks.en: For grounding, we measure if an idea’s declared source support actually carries the idea. We use this metric only for reporting (Section 5 ).

blocks.en: Source dependence score. The score we report is source-dependence . Would the idea collapse if the cited documents were removed? The judge rates this on a 1–5 rubric, from 1 (decorative: the idea stands completely without the cited documents) to 5 (the idea strictly requires the cited findings), and looks for whether the declared support names concrete findings, methods or results that the idea needs, or whether it is template rhetoric (“we extend prior work on X”) that would read the same with the citations deleted. The grounding score of an idea is the min–max rescaling g ⁡ ( u ) = dependence ​ ( u ) − 1 4 ∈ { 0 , 0.25 , 0.5 , 0.75 , 1 } , g(u)=\frac{\text{dependence}(u)-1}{4}\in\{0,\,0.25,\,0.5,\,0.75,\,1\}, (9) and the grounding of a model is the mean of g ⁡ ( u ) g(u) over all its generated ideas. The full prompt is in Prompt G .

blocks.en: We do not put grounding in the training reward, for two reasons. First, optimizing three objectives in one run proved unstable. In our initial runs, grounding entered the reward as a graded multiplier and later as a binary gate, and the policy gamed the judge’s category preferences (for example, the grounding-type distribution collapsed onto a single type). Second, grounding has no natural direction in which higher is always better. Our score measures how much an idea depends on its cited sources, so a highly grounded idea can be a simple, incremental extension of them, while a less grounded one can be a promising departure that is only loosely motivated by the documents. We therefore instruct the model at the prompt level to name the sources each idea draws on (Appendix A.1 ), and track grounding separately as a diagnostic (Section 5 ). This is a limitation of our objective: some drop in grounding is expected when ideas move away from their sources, but the drop after RL (Table 11 ) is large, because nothing in the reward penalizes drifting, and finding a stable way to enforce a floor is future work.
blocks.zh: 出于两个原因,我们不把培训奖励作为基础。 第一,一次优化三个目标证明是不稳定的。 在我们的初始运行中,地面进入奖励作为分级乘数,后来作为二进制门,政策游戏则对法官的类别偏好(例如,地面类型分布崩溃为单一类型)进行游戏。 第二,地面没有自然方向,高点总是更好的。 我们的得分衡量一个想法在多大程度上取决于它所引用的来源,因此,一个有高度基础的想法可以是一个简单、渐进的延伸,而一个没有足够基础的想法可以是一个充满希望的出发点,它只能被文件松散地激发。 因此,我们指示该模型在即时阶段列出每个设想所借鉴的来源(附录A.1),并单独追踪作为诊断的基础(第5节)。 这是对我们目标的一个限制:当想法远离其来源时,预期会有一些下降,但RL(表11)之后的下降幅度很大,因为奖励中没有任何东西会惩罚漂流,而找到一个稳定的方法来实施一个最低标准是今后的工作。

blocks.en: Why greedy reporting is sufficient. Maximizing over orderings is combinatorial, so, following CREATE, we approximate it with the greedy (farthest-point) order: take the highest-quality idea first, then repeatedly take the idea with the largest marginal value q ⁡ ( u ) ​ min j ∈ picked ⁡ d ⁡ ( u , u j ) q(u)\min_{j\in\text{picked}}d(u,u_{j}) . Because the greedy order is one particular ordering, its value is a lower bound on C ​ U ​ ( U ) CU(U) , so it can only understate a set’s CU. It also depends only on the set and not on the order in which a model happened to write its ideas, which is what we want when comparing models, especially since we have baselines where we sample from a model instead of generating a set.
blocks.zh: 何故贪报已足. 最大程度的订单是组合式的,因此,按照CREATE,我们把它与贪婪(最远点)的顺序相近:首先采取最高品质的想法,然后再三采取最大边际价值的QQQ(u) min jQQQ(u, u j )选择了QQd(u, u j ) q(u)\min_{j\in\ text{ picked}}d(u, u_{j )). 因为贪婪的秩序是特定的命令,所以其价值在C U(U) CU(U)上是一个较低的约束,所以它只能低估一个集的CU. 这也只取决于模型的设定,而不是模型写作的顺序,这是我们在比较模型时想要的,特别是因为我们有从模型中取样而不是生成一组的基线.

blocks.en: : IdeaSeed contains 11,683 source papers from two domains. Each paper comes with a proposal-style statement of its idea and 1–7 related works that directly influenced it. We use a 500-paper subset. We first drop papers with fewer than three related works, so that every instance requires synthesizing several source documents. We then sample 250 papers per domain, stratified by related-work count. For this dataset, we report (i) the normalized entropy H norm = H ⁡ ( p ) / log 2 ⁡ | ℒ | H_{\mathrm{norm}}=H(p)/\log_{2}|\mathcal{L}| , where p p is the pooled label distribution and | ℒ | = 8 |\mathcal{L}|=8 is the number of labels on the axis. It lies in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , and higher values mean ideas are spread more evenly across types. We also report (ii) the total variation distance (TVD) between the model’s label distribution and the human proposals’ distribution, and, (iii) Jensen–Shannon divergence (JSD) ( Lin, 1991 ) . For TVD and JSD, lower values mean the model’s spread of idea types is closer to the human one.

blocks.en: Gains comes from training. To separate gains from training and set-level prompting, we compare each general model’s set of K = 3 K=3 ideas against n = 3 n=3 independently sampled single-idea responses (Table 12 ). Set-level prompting raises distance sharply (0.24–0.53 to 0.79–0.86) but lowers quality for the closed-source models (e.g. win rate 0.33 to 0.21 for Claude Opus 4.8), so utility barely changes (0.34 to 0.38). Our model beats both modes on both axes, with a win rate of 0.50 and a distance of 0.88, so the balance comes from the set-level reward.
blocks.zh: 收益来自训练。 为了区分培训和定级提示的收益,我们比较了每个通用模型的K=3K=3概念和n=3n=3独立抽样的单思想反应(表12)。 设置级提示会大幅提升距离(0.24-0.53至0.79-0.86),但降低闭源模型的质量(例如Claude Opus 4.8的胜率0.33至0.21),所以实用性几乎没有变化(0.34至0.38). 我们的模型在两轴上都击败两种模式,胜率为0.50,距离为0.88,所以平衡来自于设定等级的奖励.

blocks.en: Table 12 reports the prompted sampled vs set level results. We see that prompting for a set mostly enables the models to increase their diversity/average distance, but this generally comes at a quality cost, indicating a quality-diversity trade off. For example, for Claude, the distance goes up from 0.24 to 0.80, but the win-rate drops from 0.33 to 0.21, even though the overall utility goes up (because of the big jump in distance). But this table is also to show that the major gains in the results for our proposed trained model, come from the reward training and not only the set-level prompting.

blocks.en: Table 15 shows how win-rate and grounding change for ideas as you go down a generated-set of ideas. For our trained models, the impact doesn’t seem to have that much of a change (especially for the no-think model). The think model is more instruction following and can explicitly check for the instructed ordering when generating so we see that it generates the most impactful idea first. For grounding, we see the models get less grounded as they generate the next idea. The models choose to do a simpler way of getting different ideas by moving away from the source. This trend is more prominent for the no think model compared to the think model.

blocks.en: From Table 1 we see that Proposed (no think) has a higher utility than Proposed (think). To see if this is because of the data curation, we use Claude-Sonnet-4.6 to generate forward thinking traces for the entire training set (forward-full). This model achieves a CU of 0.50, a length controlled win-rate of 0.30 and an average distance of 0.87. This also doesn’t beat our no-think baseline. Any filtering on the full-dataset for high quality and diverse set lead to substantially less instances for the SFT stage (around 1k) and there the size of the training data became another factor and it was difficult to isolate just training data structuring as a factor.
blocks.zh: 从表1可以看出,拟议(没有想法)的效用高于拟议(思考)。 为了了解这是否是因为数据解析,我们使用克劳德-索内特-4.6为整个训练集(向前-完全)产生前进思维痕迹. 该型号实现0.50CU,长度控制双增速0.30,平均距离0.87. 这也比不上我们的无思想基线。 对高质量和多样的整套全套数据进行过滤后,SFT阶段(大约1k)的事例要少得多,培训数据的规模也成为另一个因素,很难将培训数据结构孤立为一个因素。

blocks.en: Each of our four annotators first selects the ACL Rolling Review (ARR) subareas they are comfortable reviewing (e.g. LLM agents, Human-Centered NLP and Human-AI Interaction, Ethics, Bias, and Fairness). Independently, every paper in our test set is tagged with its ARR subarea by prompting an LLM classifier with the target paper’s title and abstract. We then filter the test set down to the papers whose tag falls within at least one annotator’s chosen subareas, and assign each of these papers to an annotator by matching the paper’s tag to that annotator’s selected subareas, so every rated portfolio falls within its annotator’s stated area of expertise.
blocks.zh: 我们的四位注释员各自首先选择他们自在审查的ACL滚动评论(ARR)子领域(如LLM代理,以人为本的NLP和Human-AI互动,伦理,比亚斯和公平). 独立地说,我们测试集中的每张纸都用它的ARR子区域标记,通过提示一个LLM分类器与目标纸的标题和抽象. 然后我们过滤测试到标签在至少一个注释者所选择的子领域之内的论文,并通过将论文标签与该注释者所选择的子领域相匹配,将每份论文分配给一个注释者,因此,每份评分组合都属于其注释者所宣称的专业领域。

blocks.en: We report the full performance on the IdeaSeed Benchmark in Table 17 and show the distribution of labels across the population of ideas in Figure 7 . Similar to the results in their original paper, we see the model anchoring to a few categories. The prompted baselines also have higher entropy on the Opportunity axis (0.89 for Claude Opus 4.8 and 0.80 for Qwen3-8B, against 0.67 for Proposed (no think) and 0.75 for Proposed (think)), which suggests RL may have reduced population-level type diversity on both axes. Further work is needed to see how to translate some of the diversity training measures to population level diversity while maintaining quality.

blocks.en: We walk through one run in full. The idea is a diagnostic benchmark for memory-augmented LLMs, generated by our think model. Its core claim has two parts: the suite reveals which memory mechanisms genuinely store information , and it exposes a failure mode shared across many designs . The card is shown below.
blocks.zh: 我们全程走过一次 这个想法是记忆强化LLMs的诊断基准,由我们的思想模型产生. 它的核心主张分为两部分:套房揭示了哪些内存机制真正存储信息,并暴露出在许多设计中共享的失败模式. 该卡如下所示.

blocks.en:
Idea Card for AutoResearch: Diagnostic Benchmark for Memory-Augmented LLMs Problem gap [Evidence Gap] The field of memory augmentation for
LLMs is growing rapidly, but there is no standardized, systematic way to evaluate
whether memory mechanisms actually store semantic information, support effective
retrieval, or remain stable across models and tasks, so claims about a mechanism’s
quality are largely unverified and the community lacks a shared benchmark for comparison. Core claim A diagnostic benchmark measuring whether memory representations
preserve semantic content, support contrastive retrieval, are interpretable, and remain
stable across a suite of existing memory mechanisms will reveal which mechanisms
genuinely store information and expose a common failure mode shared across many proposed
designs, enabling the field to audit and advance itself with measurable evidence rather
than untested claims. Method [Empirical Mapping] Construct an open, modular diagnostic
benchmark for memory-augmented LLMs, consisting of tasks that probe: • content fidelity : do memory vectors encode task-relevant semantics? • contrastive retrieval quality : does retrieval match ground-truth memory? • interpretability : can the stored content be inspected? • stability : does memory survive parameter perturbation and cross-model transfer? Evaluate leading memory mechanisms (DPR-style dense retrievers, SBERT-style
bi-encoders, latent memory, compressed soft-prompt memory, retraining-free long-term
memory) on this benchmark and release it as a public tool. Map which mechanisms succeed
on which subtasks and quantify the gap between them, turning anecdotal claims into
comparable, reproducible evidence.

blocks.en: NQ-Swap is not a shared failure. DPR/SBERT score 0.87--0.96 because the substituted entity is a literal surface token that lexical-ish dense matching picks up. Only the untrained latent/compressed arms (softprompt-k4 ≈ \approx chance) fail, i.e. 2 of 7 arms, which is not a ‘‘common failure mode shared across many designs.’’ The claim’s second conjunct is still untested and needs probes that can plausibly break all designs.

blocks.en: Discriminative validity: real arms beat both controls on retrieval and fidelity probe beyond bootstrap 95% CIs.
blocks.zh: 歧视性有效性:真正的武器把对检索和忠诚的探测器的控制都超越95%的CI。

blocks.en: Ranking is signal, not noise: Spearman ρ ≥ 0.7 \rho\geq 0.7 between the two disjoint data halves.
blocks.zh: 排名是信号,而不是噪音: Spearman ^ ^ 0.7\rho\geq 0.7 在两个脱节数据之间减半。

blocks.en: Common failure mode: ≥ \geq 4/7 non-control arms within 1.5 × 1.5\times chance on the same probe (P1, P2, or P3 retention ≤ \leq 0.5).
